doc.digest: Explanatory note or label (Max for Live)
doc.description: live.comment displays text which is typed into it in order to serve as a label or explanatory text. The text follows Ableton Live's color scheme, if used in a Max for Live device.

methods.name: append
methods.digest: Add text at end of current contents
methods.description: The word append followed by any message will set the live.comment object to display that message after any text which it already contains.

methods.name: prepend
methods.digest: Add text in front of current contents
methods.description: The word prepend followed by any message will set the live.comment object to display that message before any text which it already contains.

methods.name: set
methods.description: The word set followed by any message will set the live.comment object to display that message.

methods.name: setwithtruncation
methods.description: The word set followed by a symbol and a width (in pixels) will truncate the symbol to the given width. An optional third symbol will be appended onto the truncated text.
